about_the_game:
Mannequin Syndrome

They were never meant to move.

Syntrax Systems created MANE—lifelike AI mannequins designed to study customers and improve retail engagement. But a catastrophic malfunction rewrote their behavior. Now one mannequin remains active in each abandoned facility, moving only when unobserved and learning from every encounter.

What was meant to guide shoppers now stalks intruders.

Your Mission

As part of a Syntrax containment unit, you must infiltrate compromised sites, restore critical systems, uncover what went wrong, and complete shutdown protocols before the corruption spreads.

But remember—this mannequin adapts. It watches. It learns.

Core Features

Solo or Co-Op (1–4 Players) – Play alone for pure tension or work with friends where timing and communication are everything.

Tense Horror Atmosphere – Explore dark industrial sectors, maintenance halls, and sealed-off research wings filled with environmental storytelling.

Objective-Driven Missions – Each chapter features its own tasks, mechanical puzzles, and multi-stage power restoration sequences.

Adaptive AI Threat – One mannequin per level. It reacts to movement, sound, and patterns, becoming smarter the longer you survive.

Shutdown Protocols – Completing a mission requires more than hiding; you must repair systems, reroute power, and execute critical procedures.

Standalone Chapters – Each level is a self-contained scenario with unique challenges that connect to the larger mystery.

Discover the Truth

Examine a Syntrax worker’s laptop in the main menu to uncover early research notes and internal logs.
Inside each mission, find abandoned documents that reveal the events leading to the outbreak and hints about mannequin behavior.

Every file brings you closer to understanding the Syndrome—though some answers remain hidden.

Future Plans

New Locations – Additional chapters with unique facility layouts, hazards, and atmosphere.
Mannequin Variants – New mannequin types with specialized behaviors and hunting patterns.
Dynamic Threat System – Expanded AI updates to introduce more unpredictable encounters.
Expanding the Mystery – More lore fragments and corrupted data that reveal how MANE evolved beyond control.

The mannequins no longer stand still.
They move with purpose.
They stalk with intelligence.
And they kill with precision.

Mannequin Syndrome – When retail horror comes alive.
